items.title: Chief Keef Postpones Long-Awaited Chicago Return Minutes Before Show, Blames “Racist” Pilot
items.summary: For the vast majority of his career, drill originator Chief Keef has been effectively banned from performing in his Chicago hometown. Again and again, Chicago authorities made his planned appearances impossible. Even a 2015 hologram performance in nearby Indiana was shut down after one song. On Saturday night, Chief Keef was slated to play his first proper Chicago headlining show in well over a decade. It didn't happen. items.title: Helio is a new FREE and open-source music sequencer
items.summary: Helio is a free, open-source sequencer that encourages experimentation with exotic scales and microtonal temperaments. It’s important to note that Helio isn’t meant to take your project from start to finish; it’s for sketching ideas without the distractions or restrictions of a more traditional sequencer. Helio is available for macOS, Windows, Linux, and iOS/Android devices. [...] View post: Helio is a new FREE and open-source music sequencer
